title: Collate Variable Multimodal Sequences
summary: Different observations can produce different token counts.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Features are projected dimensionless embeddings; modality codes0image/1state/2text carry no physical units.

physical_contract.axes: B sequences(Li,E) -> padded tokens(B,Lmax,E), masks/IDs(B,Lmax), lengths(B)
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Each example retains its supplied token order; no cross-example temporal relationship is implied.
physical_contract.batching: B sequences(Li,E) -> padded tokens(B,Lmax,E), masks/IDs(B,Lmax), lengths(B)

provenance.authoring_notes: Original collator for PaLM-E-style multimodal embeddings. It does not tokenize text, encode images or insert supervision labels.
